# td

**Tag**: cli, devops, data

## 简介

CLI to manage data on Treasure Data, the Hadoop-based cloud data warehousing

## 官网

- 主页: http://treasure-data.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/treasure-data/td
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/td/0.19.1
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/td
